description: Consensus parameters of a ZcashHeaderRelay that follows Zcash Mainnet (script/DeployRelay.s.sol, RELAY_NETWORK=mainnet). Every value is verified in docs/ref/FACTS.md (Zebra v7.0.0-rc.0, ZIP 218, ZIP 259) and documented on ZcashHeaderRelay.RelayParams; test/relay/ZcashHeaderRelayParams.t.sol checks that this file parses to the parameters the Mainnet tests use.

notes.powLimit: PoWLimit = 2^243 - 1, rounded through its compact form 0x1f07ffff
notes.minDifficultyBlocks: Mainnet has no minimum-difficulty blocks; the relay refuses the rule with the Mainnet network id
notes.maxTimeStartHeight: 0: the 90-minute rule applies at every height (Zebra; the specification says from height 2)
notes.nu7ActivationHeight: 4294967295 = NEVER: the Mainnet NU7 height is to be set on 2026-10-20 (ZIP 259: 'TBD (To be set on OCT 20)'). A relay deployed with NEVER expects the pre-NU7 nBits for the first NU7 block, refuses it and can extend nothing above it, so set the assigned height here (from the updated ZIP 259 or Zebra's constants.rs; a multiple of 3, which DeployRelay checks) before deploying a relay that must cross NU7
notes.minCheckpointHeight: Blossom (75 s spacing) at 653,600; the relay has no pre-Blossom rules
